opponent.description: Despite being a mom in her thirties, Sanae Furukawa is in a schoolgirl disguise and calling herself "Sanako Isogai". And somehow she's cute enough to get away with it! Is Sanae here to secretly watch over Nagisa, her unsuspecting daughter, or is she here to flirt away some of the stress of married life?
